rationale: The agent did not complete the user’s multi-step request. From the visible exchange, the agent only provided the total price of the pending order (#W5061109) and did not address the user’s specific questions about the Bluetooth speaker’s price and battery life, nor the conditional cancellation of the speaker if over $300, nor checking for alternatives under $100, nor adding the cheapest qualifying item, nor confirming the new order total. There is no evidence of confirmation before any order-changing write (and no order changes were actually carried out). Although some tool calls suggest the agent may have identified the user and retrieved order/product data, the final action taken does not fulfill the user’s intended workflow per policy. Therefore, the conversation fails the pass bar.
